extractions.label: zenith_market_0_cost_to_max
extractions.expression: (() => { const index = 0; const levels = idleon.engine.getGameAttribute("Spelunk")[45]; const row = idleon.engine.getGameAttribute("CustomLists").h.ZenithMarket[index]; let total = 0; for (let level = Number(levels[index]); level < Number(row[3]); level++) { const price = level + Number(row[1]) * Math.pow(Number(row[2]), level); total += price < 1000000 ? Math.floor(price) : price; } return total; })()
extractions.description: Zenith Market 0 cost from its saved level to cap, summing source-verified Thingies.ZenithMarketCost quotes without changing saved levels or the native price cache
